description: For a person riding or running a race ("I'm running the Soweto Marathon on 1 November, here's the GPX"): add them to it and arm race day. First it finds the race already on livedot (one race, one event: never a copy) and joins them to it, findable by everyone unless they said they don't want to be; if several races match, ask the user which one and call again with race_id. Only when the race isn't on livedot, it saves their own private race from the GPX, the date and the start time. Either way, on the day they press Start on their Garmin (livedot field) or Go live in the app on the course and they're live on it. Returns their follow link on livedot.me. For races and events they signed up for; not for an off-the-cuff ride or run. A route can also come from another app's tool as its points or an encoded polyline (for example a route or activity map from a fitness app): pass it as polyline or points. Never ask the user to export a GPX if you already have the route's points.

findable.description: false only if the user doesn't want to be found by everyone (then only people with their link see them). Default true.

gpx.description: The GPX file's text (up to 5 MB): if the user pasted it, or attached a file you can read yourself (for example with code).

gpx_file.description: The GPX or route file the user attached (ChatGPT passes it here).

file_name.description: Its name, if known (the route's name; never an event's).

points.description: The route as its points: [[lat, lon], …], with elevation in metres as a third number if known. Up to 50,000. Use it for points another app's tool gave, or that you read from an attached file (GPX, FIT, TCX) with code.

polyline.description: The route as an encoded polyline (Google's format, precision 5 or 6), as another app's tool gives it (a route's or an activity's map).

race.description: The race's name, as the user said it.

race_id.description: The race the user picked from the races this tool listed.

sport.description: ride (cycling, Windline) or run (running, RunFast). Leave it out when the account has only one.

start.description: The start (gun) time, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" local to the race, if the user said it. Needed only when the race isn't on livedot yet.

tz.description: The race's IANA time zone, if known (else worked out from the route).

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

url.description: A link to the route: a Ride with GPS route, ride or collection (a collection gives one day per route), or any public link to a GPX file. Not Strava.

name: add_my_race

outputSchema.description: The race they're in now (joined, or their own when it isn't on livedot), what's armed, and their follow link.

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

armed.description: What starts it on the day, in words.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

event.description: Their own race when none was on livedot: { id, name, dashboard?, link? }.

findable.description: Findable by everyone on the race map (false: only people with their link).

follow_url.description: Their follow link on livedot.me (their livedot name, else their own follow link).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

race.description: The race joined: { id, name, date, place, km, going, url (its livedot.me page) }.

races.description: state pick: the races that match ({ id, name, date, place, km, going, url }). Ask which, then pass its id as race_id.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

state.description: joined, already (in it before), created (their own private race: none on livedot), or pick (several match: ask which).

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Add my race
